page_title: SEV 1-2 CEL | Sevilla v Celta Vigo 17/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+8' Joan Jordan (Sevilla) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
90+8' Erik Lamela (Sevilla) will deliver the corner kick.
90+7' Neat passing move from Celta Vigo in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90+6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Carles Perez (Celta Vigo).
90+4' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+3' Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Francisco Maeso didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
90+2' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Erik Lamela (Sevilla) coming on for Marcos Acuna.
89' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
88' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' The Sevilla players are stunned as referee Francisco Maeso changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
83' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Sevilla as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
82' A clumsy foul by Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle. The referee blows his whistle and awards Sevilla a penalty after chaos inside the box.
78' 1 - 2 What a goal! Jonathan Bamba swings a cross into the box and Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 1:2.
76' Today's match ends for Hugo Alvarez who will be replaced by Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
76' Here's the change. Unai Nunez leaves the pitch and Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
75' Quique Sanchez Flores has decided to substitute Oliver Torres and he is replaced by Joan Jordan (Sevilla).
75' Substitution. Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) has come on for Nemanja Gudelj.

74' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
73' Sevilla have a corner.
72' 1 - 1 Goal! Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top right corner.
72' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
68' Substitution. Hugo Sotelo makes way for Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) departs the field of play to be replaced by Jailson.
65' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

62' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Vicente Guaita, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
61' Quique Sanchez Flores prepares a substitution. Youssef En Nesyri is replaced by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla).
61' Lucas Ocampos comes off the pitch to be replaced by Suso (Sevilla).

61' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.

60' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Vicente Guaita to get hold of the ball.

58' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Isaac Romero (Sevilla) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.

58' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Orjan Nyland pulls off an easy save.

57' A clever short pass gives Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
57' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) will miss the next game.
56' Jesus Navas (Sevilla) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Francisco Maeso lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
55' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jorgen Strand Larsen.
54' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

52' What a big chance! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
50' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
50' The ratio of the ball possession is 28:72.
48' The attendance is 36554.
46' Referee Francisco Maeso blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45+3' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
45+1' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

45+1' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
45' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
45' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.

43' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Orjan Nyland blocks the shot with his legs.
42' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

42' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
39' The foul by Isaac Romero (Sevilla) was seen by Francisco Maeso who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Celta Vigo are awarded the free kick.
38' The ball falls to Oliver Torres (Sevilla) on the edge of the box, but his shot goes well wide of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
36' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picks up an injury.
32' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

32' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
32' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
31' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Celta Vigo can continue in their attacking effort.
29' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) attempts to discuss the decision with Francisco Maeso, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
29' Francisco Maeso shows the yellow card to Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) for a heavy challenge.
28' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Javier Manquillo suffers an injury and Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) comes on.
27' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

27' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Celta Vigo force a corner. They send men into the box.
25' PENALTY APPEAL after Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
23' The game is interrupted now, Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
18' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
14' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

14' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.

12' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
12' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) is about to take a corner kick.
12' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
11' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
10' Kike Salas (Sevilla) makes a rough challenge and Francisco Maeso blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Celta Vigo.
7' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) slips through the defence and passes the ball in from the edge of the box. Jorgen Strand Larsen picks it up but loses it to one of the defenders.
6' Sevilla players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
3' Good chance! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!

2' Kike Salas (Sevilla) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
2' Marcos Acuna (Sevilla) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
1' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. That's a free kick to Sevilla.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Celta Vigo will kick the game off.
Francisco Maeso was nominated as the referee for this game.
